reviews.text: Was able to get a quick appointment, everyone was friendly and got my kitty the help he needed!
The vets are always so nice, knowledgeable and comforting. The place is a bit pricey but we keep going back because of the efficiency and quality care.
Thank you for the 5-star rating, Felipe! We truly appreciate your support 💛 …
We had a great experience today! My boy had his annual checkup and vaccines. He did great and walked out ready to play! Thank you so much!
Thank you for the 5-star rating, Liam! We’re happy that you had a great Sploot vet visit! 💛 …
I’ve been taking my kitties here for years now, and the staff is always so knowledgeable and kind - especially Indigo S. who managed to make our day even better!

Dr. Perkins was sooo wonderful! She listened and was very thorough and kind. Taba C. Was great at explaining our medications and getting us ready for home. Thank you Sploot Logan Square for the great care!!
Thank you for the 5-star rating, Alicia! We’re here whenever you need us!💛 …

Half of the people who work here are wonderful.  The other half are actively trying to sabotage patient care and client experience.

This place is so close to our home, we like to use them for vaccines.  We use another vet for anything serious or complicated.

Here are two examples within this past year of Sploot's sabotage:

We walked in 7 minutes past and they have a 10 minute grace period, they let us wait at reception and didn't call us up to check in until it was just 10 past.  So they could then turn us away and say it was past our grace period.  I had been standing right in front of this lady for over 3 minutes before she would engage with me.  Then she insisted we would have to reschedule.  It was seriously bonkers.

We did a long walk to this vet, it's a couple blocks away, and my dog's body temp was higher than usual - she was panting and out of breath from the walk.  They couldn't give vaccines at that temp.  We agreed to give her some water and let her cool down then recheck her temp in 10 minutes.  Instead of doing the thing we agreed to, they took her for another 10 minute walk before checking her temp.  So they could then send us away without treatment.  Completely perplexing.  Then when I was upset about this they did not listen to a thing I said and tried to steamroll over me.  It was really unhinged behavior.

It's become where the location doesn't even guarantee convenience any more, since it's so hit or miss if we actually get services.
